routing_warnings.description: The reported reversed black-border and mustard-interior placement concerns the mustard block-colour pareo rather than the zebra print.
The requested change to 130 by 170 cm, or 133 by 173 cm with seam allowance, concerns the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The reported delivery of rescaled 133 by 173 cm files concerns the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The reported reversed black-border and mustard-interior colour placement concerns a block-colour pareo rather than the basket-weave print.
The request to resize the artwork to 130 by 170 cm, or 133 by 173 cm with seam allowance, changes the shared pareo dimension Requirement.
The claim that files were rescaled to 133 by 173 cm implements the shared pareo dimension change rather than a basket-weave-specific change.
The client changes the dimensions for the pareo artwork generally rather than changing the mustard variant's colour or border design.
The freelancer's rescaling claim belongs to the artwork-dimensions Requirement rather than this colour-design Requirement.
The reported colour-placement error explicitly concerns the mustard-interior pareo rather than the terracotta-interior variant.
The corrected-file claim responds to the mustard-interior colour-placement error.
The client changes the dimensions for the pareo artwork generally rather than the terracotta design behavior.
The freelancer reports completion of the requested artwork rescaling.
The delivery of the Technical Sheet, its colour references, file specifications, and supplier notes also belongs to the separate documentation Requirement.
The reported reversed black-border and mustard-interior artwork is a concrete design-content failure for the block-colour pareo rather than a general print-ready file-specification failure.
The corrected Tela Mare 3 file addresses the block-colour pareo design error rather than the target production-file specification.
The request to change the finished and seam-inclusive dimensions belongs to the independent artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The delivery of files rescaled to 133 x 173cm is an implementation claim for the artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The statement that the Technical Sheet still contains the previous measurements is evidence concerning the separate documentation Requirement.
